lastCompletedStory.title: Narrate supervisor block outcome at terminal-blocked notify sites

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-94) is the only story in this PRD. All six terminal-blocked notifyOrchestrator sites in loop.ts now narrate `[cam] <storyId> BLOCKED: <detail>` (using lastOutcome.detail) instead of formatWorkerReportSummary(r). The three happy-path sites (supervisor-finalized-pass continue, genuine-advance, PRD_COMPLETE) still call formatWorkerReportSummary. The review-branch BLOCKED site is unchanged. File-size budget raised for loop.test.ts (2810->2966).
